definitions.explanation: A senior member of the government who heads a ministry and is part of the cabinet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{外務|がいむ}→外務：24160_gaimu⟧{大臣|だいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new Foreign Minister was appointed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{総理大臣|そうりだいじん}→総理大臣：15205_souridaijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The Prime Minister held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {大臣|だいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{大臣|だいじん} refers to a minister in the national government who heads a ministry and serves in the ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧ (Cabinet). It appears as a suffix after the ministry name.

MAJOR CABINET POSITIONS:
- ⟦{総理大臣|そうりだいじん}→総理大臣：15205_souridaijin⟧ / ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧: Prime Minister
- ⟦{外務|がいむ}→外務：24160_gaimu⟧{大臣|だいじん}: Foreign Minister
- ⟦{財務|ざいむ}→財務：05971_zaimu⟧{大臣|だいじん}: Finance Minister
- ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧{大臣|だいじん}: Defense Minister
- ⟦{文部科学|もんぶかがく}→文部科学：28863_monbukagaku⟧{大臣|だいじん}: Education Minister

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大臣|だいじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be appointed as minister
- {大臣|だいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a minister resigns
- {大臣|だいじん}⟦{経験者|けいけんしゃ}→経験者：18664_keikensha⟧: former minister

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧: the Cabinet
- ⟦{省|しょう}→省：noentry⟧: ministry (e.g., ⟦{外務|がいむ}→外務：24160_gaimu⟧⟦{省|しょう}→省：noentry⟧)
- ⟦{官房長官|かんぼうちょうかん}→官房長官：28164_kanbouchoukan⟧: Chief Cabinet Secretary

NOTE:
In casual speech and media, ministers are often referred to by portfolio alone — e.g., ⟦{外務|がいむ}→外務：24160_gaimu⟧{大臣|だいじん} or simply ⟦{外相|がいしょう}→外相：noentry⟧ (abbreviated form).
